Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really appreciated the openness from your product and data teams. Per our call, the best next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive that brings in Acme's ML and infra leads so we can:

- Walk through your model/inference requirements (latency targets, throughput, burst patterns)
- Review current infra (GPUs, orchestration, data flow) and constraints (VPC, data residency)
- Validate integration points (APIs, auth, telemetry) and data access for evaluation
- Discuss Redwood's recommended serving/quantization profiles and rollout plan

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed, Mar 17 — 10:00–11:30am PT
- Thu, Mar 18 — 10:00–11:15am PT (75m)
- Fri, Mar 19 — 9:00–10:30am PT

Suggested agenda (attached PDF): 1) Introductions & goals (10m) 2) Architecture + data requirements (20m) 3) Walkthrough of a sample inference flow (20m) 4) Q&A + next steps / MAP (15–25m).

Can you confirm which slot works best and who from your ML/infra team will join (names + emails)? Also: if you can share a high-level architecture diagram or allowed sample telemetry ahead of the call, that will help the team be prepared — if there are restrictions, a diagram is perfect.

Attaching: redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite for the time you pick.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right people on the call.
